reason: The single ORA #&40 wrap is only equal to the original's two CMP/ADC wraps if X (the address high byte) is in &40-&7F on entry, and that is not true on every path. movers_screen_address_low/high are zero-initialised tables (src/game.6502 836-842) and are written only by calculate_screen_addresses_for_mover_on_edge (1847), the move (2977), use_player_position (3013), projectiles (4225) and the shield's rewind. Enemy helicopters (slots &0A/&0B) are placed by add_enemy_helicopters (2707) with x, y and type but no screen address, and update_enemy_helicopter -> check_if_mover_can_be_updated (4647) updates a mover up to viewport_right + &0A, i.e. while it is still off screen to the right and before the edge code gives it an address. The first helicopter in each slot after boot therefore moves with movers_screen_address_high = &00. A move up toward an airborne target (y_delta 1-3 rows, AND #&83) goes check_for_collision_after_vertical_move -> subtract_Y_rows_from_screen_address_in_AX with A = &00, X = &00. Then line = 0, so it takes the crossing path: Y = 0, L1 = 0, no borrow, v1 = 0. The original wraps that to &40, CPY #&80 gives C = 0, SBC #2 gives &3D, which wraps to X = &7D. The candidate gives 0 - 2 - 1 = &FD, ORA &40 = &FD. movers_screen_address_high then differs (game state inside movers_state_end, which passlock and helilock compare), and add/subtract_delta carry the out-of-ring value on until the edge recomputes it. The candidate's evidence does not cover this. Its 20,000 emulator calls and passlock runs come from scripts that never board a helicopter (CLAUDE.md: passlock's scripts never board one), so no enemy helicopter targets anything in the air. Its claim that 'every screen address starts at screen_start_address_high' does not hold for the zero-initialised slots. Everything else checks out. Byte count 52 -> 37 (15). Cycles on the usual crossing path (both wrap branches taken) 68 -> 54, saving 14, or up to 1 more per untaken wrap. &76 has no other reader (zp.6502 has no other name for it; bank 5 uses &77). ru_lo is read nowhere after this point. ru_in_ring/ru_in_ring_2 have no other references. No ROMSEL/ANDY/ACCCON issue (main RAM and zero page code). It fits (it shrinks moved_0a20). But the precondition fails on a real path the proofs never run, so the change is refuted.
